What a bite does

Type A neurotoxin causes progressive weakness/paralysis over hours; local tissue damage is often mild relative to other rattlesnakes.

Antivenom source. USA.

Name and taxonomy. Type A venom = neurotoxic Mojave toxin population.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
